# Assuming the water has been treated to meet standards approved by the
# Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) for the protection of
# public health and the environment, how comfortable would you feel if your
# city or town used treated municipal wastewater for the following
# purposes: As drinking water for people
#
# S3OK Public Survey, University of Oklahoma Institute for Public
# Policy Research and Analysis. Rebuilds this chart from the public
# wave files and nothing else.
# Wave 7.

library(tidyverse)
library(srvyr)

# Read as character: a column that is empty for its first thousand rows
# is otherwise guessed logical, which turns every real value after it
# into NA.
wave_7 <- read_csv(
  "Public_Wave_7_Survey_Data.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)

d <- bind_rows(
  wave_7 |>
    transmute(
      p_id,
      resp = mw_drnk
    )
) |>
  filter(!is.na(resp))

# The survey is a panel, so one person can answer in several waves. The
# design clusters on the panelist: percentages are unweighted shares of
# responses, and the intervals allow for repeated answers.
est <- d |>
  as_survey_design(ids = p_id) |>
  group_by(resp) |>
  summarise(
    p = survey_prop(proportion = TRUE, vartype = "ci"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

est <- est |>
  mutate(
    p = 100 * p, p_low = 100 * p_low, p_upp = 100 * p_upp,
    resp = factor(
      resp,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      labels = c("Very uncomfortable", "Uncomfortable", "Neutral",
                 "Comfortable", "Very comfortable")
    )
  )

ggplot(est, aes(x = p, y = fct_rev(resp))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = p_low, xmax = p_upp),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap(paste(
      "Assuming the water has been treated to meet standards",
      "approved by the Oklahoma Department of Environmental",
      "Quality (DEQ) for the protection of public health and the",
      "environment, how comfortable would you feel if your city or",
      "town used treated municipal wastewater for the following",
      "purposes: As drinking water for people"
    ), 70),
    x = "Share of respondents (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
